name: Smallest k such that Product_{i=0..n} (k-i) divides C(2*k,k).
comment: Minimality of a(8)-a(13) is certified by exhaustive search combined with a provably complete small-prime sieve that guards against theoretical false negatives (checking all primes p < 2n+1 for each candidate). The completeness of this screen follows from the Small Prime Barrier Theorem (formally verified in Lean 4 + Mathlib): any non-governor witness must have governor failures confined to primes below 2n+1. See Dehorty link. - _Justin Dehorty_, Mar 23 2026
link: Justin Dehorty, Witness Search for Erdos Problem #396 (exhaustive search, validation certificates, and Lean 4 formal proof of the Small Prime Barrier Theorem).
Justin Dehorty, Catalogue of Search Algorithm Optimizations for this sequence.
